title: Mixing: Goodnight Tonight, Daytime Nighttime Suffering by Wings | 1979
content:
Replica Studio, London
Producers: Paul McCartney, Chris Thomas

A mixing session for Wings’ ‘Goodnight Tonight’ single took place on 23 January 1979.

Paul McCartney oversaw mixes of the song and its b-side, ‘Daytime Nighttime Suffering’. Although the recording of the latter was deemed complete, it was remixed on 30 January, 1 February, and 2 March 1979.

‘Goodnight Tonight’ had new lead vocals added on 24 January, and was mixed again on 29 and 30 January, 1, 5, 8, and 9 February, and 2 March.
